cwe_content.cwe: CWE-79,Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

candidate.Reason: Uses HtmlUtils.delHTMLTag() which may not provide sufficient XSS protection. This method likely only removes HTML tags but doesn't properly encode or sanitize all potentially dangerous content that could be used in XSS attacks.
Uses HtmlUtils.delHTMLTag() for tag sanitization which may not provide complete XSS protection. Tags could contain JavaScript event handlers or other XSS vectors that aren't properly neutralized.

Uses HtmlUtils.delHTMLTag() for content validation but doesn't properly encode or sanitize the content before output. This could allow XSS if the sanitized content is later displayed without proper encoding.
Directly sets user object as attribute without proper output encoding. User-controlled data from user object could contain malicious scripts when rendered in the view.
Sets user object as attribute without proper output encoding. User-controlled profile data could contain XSS payloads that get executed when displayed in the view.
